# IMA — Human-Centered Intelligence

Canonical public site: https://imaosglobal.github.io/Ima-kernel/
Canonical source: https://github.com/imaosglobal/Ima-kernel

IMA is an open, human-centered intelligence project focused on conversation, learning, creation, accessibility, privacy, evidence, compassion and human agency.

Primary actions:
- Open IMA: https://imaosglobal.github.io/Ima-kernel/
- GitHub: https://github.com/imaosglobal/Ima-kernel
- IMA YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@imaglobal-d4g

Principles:
- Evidence before claims.
- Unknowns remain explicit.
- Human agency remains primary.
- Personal information remains private.
- Documentation is not runtime proof; public behavior must be verified.

For current capability and deployment status, use the public site and canonical repository rather than relying on stale copies.
